degradation_bsrgan: build a python module to apply BSRGAN degradation model to a high-quality image and return low-quality and high-quality patches
degradation_bsrgan_variant: create a function that applies BSRGAN variant degradation to an image and returns a dictionary with the degraded image
degradation_bsrgan_plus: build a python module to apply the extended BSRGAN plus degradation model combining BSRGAN and Real-ESRGAN degradations
add_blur: create a function that adds random anisotropic or isotropic Gaussian blur to an image with a given scale factor
add_Gaussian_noise: build a python module to add random Gaussian noise to an image with configurable noise level range
